reason: I have strictly avoided third-party cloud tools because client confidentiality is paramount, so I will not pay for any software until I verify that Google Drive access is truly quarantined. Furthermore, with article clerks rotating every two to three years, I refuse to invest money in a system if training them turns into an administrative headache.
objection: Connecting any third-party tool to our Google Drive makes me anxious about data leaks, and I doubt whether their laptop shield can genuinely stop rotating article clerks from saving sensitive client files to personal laptops.
would_change_my_mind: Clear, verifiable technical proof during the free pilot that Docketra cannot touch files outside its dedicated folder and that article clerks are completely blocked from downloading client documents to personal machines.
